summary: The LLM landscape in 2026 is dominated by a handful of frontier models, with ChatGPT/GPT-5 retaining majority consumer mindshare at ~54-56% of AI chatbot web visits while Gemini has surged dramatically (~28%) on the strength of deep Google ecosystem integration. Enterprise API adoption tells a different story, with Anthropic's Claude leading at 40% of enterprise API usage, followed by OpenAI at 27% and Google at 21%, reflecting Claude's strong positioning in secure, multi-cloud deployments. Open-source models from Meta, Alibaba, DeepSeek, and Mistral have closed the benchmark gap significantly, giving developers credible self-hosted alternatives to proprietary frontier models.

models.name: GPT-5
models.popularity_notes: Holds ~54-56% of global AI chatbot web-visit share as of mid-2026 and leads LLM API provider rankings; available on Azure OpenAI Service, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI, giving it unmatched enterprise aggregator reach.
strengths: Highest consumer and developer mindshare globally
Exceptional multi-step reasoning and conversational ability
Broad aggregator availability (Azure, AWS, Vertex)
Large ecosystem of integrations and plugins
Strong real-time interaction capabilities
models.best_for: General-purpose enterprise and consumer applications requiring strong reasoning, dialogue, and multi-modal capabilities

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Gemini reached ~28% global web-visit share in May 2026, up ~450% year-over-year to 2.9 billion monthly visits, driven by deep integration with Google Workspace, Android, and native availability on Google Vertex AI.
strengths: Industry-leading 1M token context window
Native Google ecosystem integration (Workspace, Search, Android)
Strong multimodal capabilities
Available on Vertex AI with enterprise SLAs
Fastest year-over-year growth of any frontier model
models.best_for: Long-document analysis, multimodal enterprise workflows, and Google ecosystem-native deployments

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.popularity_notes: Claude holds 40% of enterprise API usage per Menlo Ventures 2025 data and ~9.2% consumer web-visit share with 952M monthly visits in May 2026, up 855% YoY; available on AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI, making it the top enterprise API model by spend.
strengths: Leads enterprise API adoption at 40% market share
Best-in-class safety and constitutional AI design
Available on AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI
Superior instruction-following and long-context comprehension
Strong coding and analysis performance
models.best_for: Enterprise applications requiring safe, reliable, high-stakes reasoning such as legal, medical, and compliance workflows

models.name: Llama 4
models.popularity_notes: Llama remains the most-downloaded open-weight model family on HuggingFace with hundreds of millions of cumulative downloads; Llama 4 is available on AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex, giving it the broadest aggregator footprint of any open-source model.
strengths: Most widely downloaded open-weight model family
Available across all major cloud aggregators
Strong general reasoning and instruction following
Massive fine-tuning and community ecosystem
No licensing cost for self-hosted deployments
models.best_for: Self-hosted and on-premise deployments where data privacy, customization, and cost control are priorities

models.name: DeepSeek-V3 / V4-Pro
models.popularity_notes: DeepSeek holds ~4.1% of global AI chatbot web-visit share in May 2026 and its V4-Pro (1.6T parameter MoE, released April 2026) leads open-weight benchmark leaderboards, achieving ~80% on SWE-Bench Verified and topping OpenRouter API traffic for open models.
strengths: State-of-the-art open-weight performance at frontier level
Extremely cost-efficient training and inference
1M token context window
Strong coding and reasoning benchmarks
Most cost-competitive API pricing among frontier-class models
models.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers and enterprises needing frontier-level reasoning with open-weight flexibility or very low API costs

models.name: Grok-3
models.popularity_notes: Grok holds ~2.4% of global AI chatbot web-visit share in May 2026 with deep integration into X (Twitter), giving it unique real-time social data access; available through xAI API and increasingly adopted by developers via OpenRouter.
strengths: Real-time information access via X platform integration
Strong reasoning and coding performance
Witty and less-filtered conversational style
Competitive benchmark scores against frontier models
Growing developer API adoption
models.best_for: Applications requiring real-time web and social media data, news analysis, and current-events reasoning

models.name: Qwen3 / Qwen3-235B
models.popularity_notes: The Qwen family has been adopted by over 90,000 enterprises and Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking redefined the open-weights landscape in 2026 with top-tier multilingual and coding performance; heavily used in Asia-Pacific enterprise deployments and available via Alibaba Cloud.
strengths: Adopted by 90,000+ enterprises
Best-in-class multilingual capabilities
Strong coding and mathematical reasoning
Open weights with competitive benchmark scores
Dominant in Asia-Pacific enterprise market
models.best_for: Multilingual enterprise applications, Asia-Pacific deployments, and teams needing open-weight models with strong coding ability

models.name: Mistral Large
models.popularity_notes: Mistral remains a top-5 most-used model on OpenRouter by request volume and is available on AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex, making it the most aggregator-distributed European model and a leading choice for speed-sensitive enterprise API use.
strengths: Best latency-to-performance ratio among frontier-class models
Available on all major cloud aggregators
Strong European data residency and compliance story
Efficient architecture with low serving cost
Solid multilingual performance
models.best_for: Latency-sensitive enterprise APIs, European data-residency requirements, and cost-efficient production deployments

models.name: Microsoft Copilot (GPT-5 based)
models.popularity_notes: Microsoft Copilot holds ~1.3% of global AI chatbot web-visit share but commands massive enterprise reach through deep integration into Microsoft 365, Teams, and Azure OpenAI Service, effectively making GPT-5 the engine for hundreds of millions of enterprise Office users.
models.cost_input: Bundled with M365 subscription; Azure OpenAI pricing applies for API
models.cost_output: Bundled with M365 subscription; Azure OpenAI pricing applies for API
strengths: Bundled into Microsoft 365 for enterprise users
Seamless integration with Word, Excel, Teams, and Outlook
Backed by Azure OpenAI enterprise SLAs
Broad enterprise IT procurement familiarity
Strong document and data analysis workflows
models.best_for: Microsoft 365 enterprise environments where AI assistance is embedded directly into productivity workflows

models.name: Perplexity (API)
models.popularity_notes: Perplexity holds ~1.3% of global AI chatbot web-visit share and its Sonar API, which combines real-time web search with LLM responses, has seen strong developer adoption for search-augmented generation use cases on OpenRouter and direct API.
strengths: Native real-time web search grounding
Cited and verifiable answers by default
Strong developer adoption for RAG-adjacent use cases
Competitive API pricing
Growing enterprise search-augmented generation adoption
models.best_for: Search-augmented generation, research assistants, and applications requiring up-to-date cited information from the web

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.popularity_notes: Tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at score 66 as of September 2026 and leads Claude Opus 5 on all Anthropic benchmarks, representing Anthropic's most capable model and driving increased enterprise API upgrades within Anthropic's already-leading 40% enterprise share.
strengths: Top score on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
Outperforms Claude Opus 5 on all published benchmarks
Available on AWS Bedrock and Vertex AI
Best-in-class instruction following
Strong enterprise safety guarantees
models.best_for: Highest-stakes enterprise reasoning tasks where maximum capability and safety are both required, including complex agentic workflows
